[Section] Annotation Scheme
[source_id=28] Two example annotations are illustrated in Figure 1. First line in every annotation consists of tweet id. Each tweet is enclosed within <tweet></tweet> tags and each word is enclosed within <word lang=“ ”></word> containing the language annotation for each word. Last line determines the category in which the tweet belongs i.e. humorous or non-humorous, enclosed by <class></class> tags. The annotated dataset with the classification system is made available online .
